EB200: Eddie Bauer's full-zip fleece is the piece we reach for when the recipient list is broad and mixed — the gift that gets worn instead of stored. The brand's own contrast logo sits on the right chest, which leaves the left chest clear for yours, and the fleece face holds an embroidered mark without the letters sinking into the nap. Where the soft shells read executive, this one reads approachable: new-hire welcome kits, volunteer crews, and the layer that lives in the truck from October through spring.
